# Joshua B. Evans

> Personal academic website of Joshua B. Evans, Lecturer in Computer Science at the University of Bath. Research focuses on reinforcement learning, particularly hierarchical reinforcement learning, skill discovery, graph-based methods, representation learning, and intrinsic motivation.

This site contains information about Joshua B. Evans' research, publications, teaching, student supervision, research software, and academic activities. For publication metadata and research outputs, prefer the Publications page; for dated professional and research updates, use the News page.

## Academic Profile and Research

- [Homepage](https://ueva.dev/): Overview of Joshua B. Evans' academic role, research interests, reinforcement learning teaching, student supervision, featured research, and recent news.
- [Publications](https://ueva.dev/publications.html): Publication list with bibliographic information, summaries, and links to papers, preprints, supplementary material, and source code where available.
- [News](https://ueva.dev/news.html): Chronological record of research publications, conference presentations, teaching developments, academic appointments, awards, and other professional activities.
- [Supervision](https://ueva.dev/supervision.html): Undergraduate and master's dissertation projects supervised by Joshua B. Evans, including project titles and student programmes.
- [Software](https://ueva.dev/software.html): Research software for reinforcement learning, including SimpleOptions, SimpleEnvs, and OfficeWorld, with links to their source repositories.

## Contact and Profiles

- [Contact](https://ueva.dev/contact.html): Academic and professional contact details, University of Bath affiliation and office location, and links to external academic and professional profiles.

- [Blog](https://ueva.dev/blog.html): Personal blog area. No blog posts are currently published.
